title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Conveyancing Paralegal - Birmingham

Are you an experienced Property Paralegal/Case Handler with specific experience in home ownership matters looking to join a law firm that that can provide genuine progression prospects, technical work along with genuine flexibility to work mostly from home?

The role

This reputable Legal 500 law firm in Birmingham is seeking a specialist in home ownership matters to carry a caseload for Registered Providers of Social Housing, handling matters from instruction through to completion under supervision. The role offers varied, client-focused work within a specialist property practice

The role will involve a varied range of home ownership and residential property matters, including:
- Shared ownership staircasing and final staircasing transactions
- Lease extensions
- Buyback transactions
- Deeds of variation and deeds of covenant
- Lease surrender and regrant arrangements
- Residential enfranchisement matters
- Auction sales

About You

The ideal candidate will have specific home ownership experience and be confident managing a varied caseload.

The firm is looking for:
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills
- A good understanding of conveyancing risk, regulatory requirements and compliance
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- A proactive and client-focused approach
- The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively to deadlines

Benefits

The firm offers a range of benefits, including:
- City-centre offices in Birmingham
- On-site café and free gym facilities at the Birmingham office
- Hybrid working. 3/4 days from home
- 25 days' annual leave, plus two additional gift days at Christmas
- Three days' paid leave for social purpose volunteering
- IT equipment and support for effective home working
- An excellent development and training programme
- Opportunities to develop and grow sector expertise

Apply

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Property Paralegal to join a specialist property team and develop their expertise within the social housing and residential conveyancing sector. To apply please contact Rebecca Healey at G2 Legal or apply online.

title: Employment Paralegal, Birmingham, &;24,000 - &;28,000 DOE, Excellent training, Legal 500
description:
Employment Paralegal, Birmingham, £24,000 - £28,000 DOE, Excellent training

The Firm

A Legal 500 recognised law firm is looking to strengthen its Birmingham Employment Team with an ambitious Employment Paralegal. The firm has built a strong reputation for challenging traditional approaches to legal services and is a ground breaker when it comes to legal technology. Combining high-quality legal expertise with innovative technology and a commercially focused approach, the firm offers an environment where ambitious junior lawyers can develop their careers while gaining exposure to a modern way of delivering legal services.

The Role
- Join an established and highly regarded Employment Team based in Birmingham.
- Work predominantly on defendant-side employment matters, representing and advising employers and businesses.
- Support solicitors across a varied caseload of contentious and non-contentious employment matters.
- Assist with Employment Tribunal claims, from ACAS Early Conciliation through to hearings.
- Gain exposure to unfair dismissal, discrimination, whistleblowing, TUPE and breach of contract matters.
- Assist with the preparation of pleadings, witness statements, chronologies, bundles and legal correspondence.
- Conduct legal and factual research and prepare case summaries.
- Assist with settlement agreements, employment contracts, policies and HR-related advice.
- Review and organise evidence and supporting documentation.
- Liaise with employer clients, colleagues and third parties.
- Develop your understanding of the commercial and legal risks facing employers.
- Work within a firm that embraces technology and continually looks for innovative ways to improve the delivery of legal services.

If you could spend your first year working predominantly on the defendant side of employment disputes while receiving excellent training from experienced employment lawyers, how much could that accelerate your development?

You
- Have a law degree or equivalent legal qualification.
- Have previous paralegal or legal experience, ideally within employment law or litigation.
- Have a genuine interest in pursuing a career in employment law.
- Possess strong legal research, analytical and organisational skills.
- Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Demonstrate strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- Are commercially aware and interested in understanding the wider impact of employment disputes on businesses.
- Are proactive, motivated and keen to take responsibility.
- Are comfortable working in an environment that embraces technology and innovation.
- Have the ambition to progress your career within employment law.
- Previous experience of Employment Tribunal proceedings would be advantageous but is not essential.

And if you knew that previous paralegals within the team have successfully progressed towards qualification, wouldn't this be the kind of platform you'd want to build your legal career on?

Benefits
- £24,000 - £28,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Excellent training and development.
- Hybrid working.
- Opportunity to join a Legal 500 recognised firm.
- Predominantly defendant-side employment work, advising and representing employers.
- Exposure to both contentious and non-contentious employment matters.
- Hands-on experience of Employment Tribunal proceedings.
- Opportunity to work on complex employment disputes involving discrimination, whistleblowing, unfair dismissal and TUPE.
- Support and development from experienced employment lawyers.
- Exposure to a broad range of employment issues and commercial clients.
- Opportunity to develop commercial awareness alongside technical legal skills.
- Work within a firm recognised for its innovative approach to legal technology.
- Collaborative and supportive working environment.
- Genuine opportunities for long-term career progression.
- The chance to develop towards a future career as an employment solicitor.

Ready to take your first or next step in employment law with a Legal 500 firm that is doing things differently? Contact Toby Ryan at QED Legal today for a confidential conversation and find out where this opportunity could take your career.

description:
Job Title: Paralegal

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.

- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.
